55002: These counters track the number of security resources and handles used per process.
55006: This counter tracks the number of credential handles in use by a given process.  Credential handles are handles to pre-existing credentials, such as a password, that are associated with a user and are established through a system logon.
55010: This counter tracks the number of context handles in use by a given process.  Context handles are associated with security contexts established between a client application and a remote peer.
56002: These counters track authentication performance on a per second basis.
56006: This counter tracks the number of NTLM authentications processed per second for the AD on this DC or for local accounts on this member server.
56010: This counter tracks the number of times that clients use a ticket to authenticate to this computer per second.
56014: This counter tracks the number of Authentication Service (AS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second. Clients use AS requests to obtain a ticket-granting ticket.
56018: This counter tracks the number of ticket-granting service (TGS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second. Clients use these TGS requests to obtain a service ticket, which allows a client to access resources on other computers.
56022: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) entries that are currently stored in the secure channel (Schannel) session cache.  The Schannel session cache stores information about successfully established sessions, such as SSL session IDs.  Clients can use this information to reconnect to a server without performing a full SSL handshake.
56026: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) entries that are currently stored in the secure channel (Schannel) session cache and that are currently in use.  The Schannel session cache stores information about successfully established sessions, such as SSL session IDs.  Clients can use this information to reconnect to a server without performaing a full SSL handshake.
56030: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) full client-side handshakes that are being processed per second.  During a handshake, signals are exchanged to acknowledge that communication can occur between computers or other devices.
56034: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) client-side reconnect handshakes that are being processed per second.  Reconnect handshakes allow session keys from previous SSL sessions to be used to resume a client/server connection, and they require less memory to process than full handshakes.
56038: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) full server-side handshakes that are being processed per second.  During a handshake, signals are exchanged to acknowledge that communication can occur between computers or other devices.
56042: This counter tracks the number of Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) server-side reconnect handshakes that are being processed per second.  Reconnect handshakes allow session keys from previous SSL sessions to be used to resume a client/server connection, and they require less memory to process than full handshakes.
56046: This counter tracks the number of Digest authentications that are being processed per second.
56050: This counter tracks the number of Kerberos requests that a read-only domain controller (RODC) forwards to its hub, per second.  This counter is tracked only on a RODC.
56054: This counter tracks the number of armored Authentication Service (AS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second.
56058: This counter tracks the number of armored ticket-granting service (TGS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second.
56062: This counter tracks the number of Authentication Service (AS) requests explicitly requesting claims that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second.
56064: KDC claims-aware service asserted identity TGS requests
56065: KDC claims-aware service asserted identity TGS requests
56066: This counter tracks the number of service asserted identity (S4U2Self) TGS requests that are explicitly requesting claims. These requests are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second.
56068: KDC classic type constrained delegation TGS Requests
56069: KDC classic type constrained delegation TGS Requests
56070: This counter tracks the number of constrained delegation (S4U2Proxy) TGS requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) by checking classic type constrained delegation configuration per second. The classic type constrained delegation is restricted to a single domain and configures the backend services SPN on the middle-tier services account object.
56072: KDC resource type constrained delegation TGS Requests
56073: KDC resource type constrained delegation TGS Requests
56074: This counter tracks the number of constrained delegation (S4U2Proxy) TGS requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) by checking the resource type constrained delegation per second. The resource type constrained delegation can cross domain boundaries and configures the middle-tiers account on the backend services account object.
56078: This counter tracks the number of claims-aware ticket-granting service (TGS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second. A claims-aware Kerberos client will always request claims during Authentication Service (AS) exchanges.
56082: This counter tracks the number of key trust Authentication Service (AS) requests that are being processed by the Key Distribution Center (KDC) per second.
57002: The LSA Lookup performance counter set consists of counters that measure performance of LSA Account name and SID lookups.
57006: This counter displays the rate of inbound account name lookup requests from local and network clients to the local LSA.
57010: This counter displays the rate of outbound account name lookup requests from the local LSA to remote servers.
57014: This counter displays the rate of incoming isolated name lookup requests to the LSA.
57018: This counter displays the rate of isolated name lookup requests going off box remotely on a Domain Controller.
57022: This counter displays the average completion time of an LsaLookupNames call.
57026: The base value used to calculate the average completion time of an LsaLookupNames call.
57030: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on remote server to service a name lookup request.
57034: The base value used to calculate the average completion time of a remote lookup request.
57038: This counter displays the rate of LsaLookupNames call errors per second.
57042: This counter displays the rate of unresolved names per second.
57046: This counter displays the % name requests resolved from the SID/Name cache.
57050: Invisible base counter for name cache hit counter.
57054: This counter displays the % of SID/name cache that is full.
57058: Base counter for name cache % full counter.
57062: This counter displays the current maximum size of the LSA Name/SID Lookup cache.
57066: This counter displays the rate of LSA Name lookups in trusted forests per second.
57070: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on a remote server to service a Xforest name lookup request.
57074: Invisible counter for base value used to calculate the average wait time for completion of a Xforest name lookup request.
57078: This counter displays the rate of LSA Name lookups in trusted Domains per second.
57082: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on a remote server in a trusted domain to service a name lookup request.
57086: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average wait time for completion of a Trusted Domain lookup request.
57090: This counter displays the rate of remote LSA Name lookups in Primary Domain per second.
57094: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on a remote server in the primary domain to service a name lookup request.
57098: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average wait time for completion of a remote name lookup request in Primary Domain.
57102: This counter displays the rate of inbound SID lookup requests from local and network clients to the local LSA.
57106: This counter displays the rate of outbound SID lookup requests from the local LSA to remote servers.
57110: This counter displays the average completion time of an LsaLookupSids call.
57114: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average completion time of an LsaLookupSids call.
57118: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on remote server to service a SID lookup request.
57122: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average wait time for completion of a remote SID lookup request.
57126: This counter displays the rate of LsaLookupSid call errors per second.
57130: This counter displays the rate of unresolved SIDs per second.
57134: This counter displays the % SID requests resolved from the cache.
57138: Invisible base counter for SID Cache hit counter.
57142: This counter displays the % of SID cache that is full.
57146: Invisible base counter for SID cache % full counter.
57150: This counter displays the rate of SID lookups in trusted forests per second.
57154: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on remote server to service a Xforest SID lookup request.
57158: invisible base counter used to calculate the average wait time for completion of a Xforest SID lookup request.
57162: This counter displays the rate of LSA SID lookups for trusted Domains per second.
57166: This counter displays the time LSA spent waiting on remote server in a trusted domain to service a SID lookup request.
57170: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average wait time for completion of SID lookup request in a Trusted Domain.
57174: This counter displays the rate of remote LSA SID lookups in Primary Domain per second.
57178: This counter displays the average time it took for a remote server to service a SID lookup request in Primary Domain.
57182: Invisible base counter used to calculate the average completion time of a remote SID lookup request in Primary Domain.
57186: The number of SID/Name entries added to the cache
57190: The number of SID/Name entries purged from the cache
